meta.name: using-git-worktrees
meta.description: Use when starting feature work that needs isolation from current workspace or before executing implementation plans - ensures an isolated workspace exists via native tools or git worktree fallback

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建隔离工作区进行特性开发
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在当前工作区外独立开发新功能
copy.tagline_en: Create isolated workspaces for feature development
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to work on a new feature without affecting your current workspace

howto.what: 开始功能开发前，Claude 会先检测当前是否已在隔离工作区；没有就征得同意后创建 worktree（优先原生工具，否则用 git worktree），再装依赖、跑基线测试并报告结果。
howto.when: 当你开始需要与当前工作区隔离的功能开发时，或在执行实现计划之前触发。

say.text: 帮我开一个隔离的 worktree 来做这个新功能
say.note: 它先检测是否已在隔离工作区，再决定是否创建

say.text: 在这个 worktree 里跑一遍基线测试
say.note: 测试失败会报告并询问是否继续

say.text: 这个项目用 .worktrees 目录放 worktree
say.note: 声明过的目录偏好会照用，不再询问

howto.what_en: Before feature work, Claude checks if you're already in an isolated workspace; if not, it asks consent, creates a worktree (native tool first, git fallback), then installs deps, runs baseline tests, and reports.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you start feature work that needs isolation from the current workspace, or before executing implementation plans.

say_en.text: Set up an isolated worktree for this new feature
say_en.note: It detects existing isolation first, then asks before creating

say_en.text: Run the baseline tests in this worktree
say_en.note: Failed tests are reported and it asks whether to proceed

say_en.text: Use .worktrees as the worktree directory for this project
say_en.note: A declared preference is honored without asking
